POV: you finally found the good Bún Quậy in Phu Quoc.

Bún quậy THIỆN MỸ on Đường Trần Hưng Đạo has 439 reviews and a 4.7-star rating. That's not luck. That's a locals' staple that keeps delivering.

Bún quậy is Phu Quoc's own noodle dish. Soft rice noodles, fresh seafood, rich broth. You stir it yourself at the table. Hence the name.

Budget around $15-30 per person. Worth every dollar.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
